name: team_2007
caption:
IF OUR 2007 WE BELIEVE CORE WERE POKÉMON 🎮🏀

🐻‍❄️ Baron Davis = Beartic: fights with fangs and claws of ice. 25.3 a night in the playoffs, and the dunk over Kirilenko
🌿 Jason Richardson = Sceptile: leaps from branch to branch to strike. 2-time dunk contest champ, 19.1 a night in the playoffs
⚓ Stephen Jackson = Dhelmise: its anchor can KO a Wailord in one blow. 33 points and 7 threes to finish off the top seed
🥋 Matt Barnes = Sawk: tying its belt gets it pumped. 42.2% from three in the playoffs
🦡 Monta Ellis = Zangoose: dodges attacks with incredible agility. 16.5 a night and Most Improved Player

The 8 seed that took down the 1 seed. Who would you change? 👇

facts.claim: 3P% = three-point (3) field goal percentage, as listed by ESPN
Our starters in series-clinching Game 6 vs Dallas, May 3, 2007 (111-86): Stephen Jackson, Matt Barnes, Andris Biedrins, Baron Davis, Jason Richardson
2006-07 Warriors: eighth (8) seed in the West, beat the top-seeded (1 seed) Dallas Mavericks 4-2 in the first round
Davis: memorable dunk over Andrei Kirilenko in the 2007 playoffs; averaged 25.3 points in the 2007 playoffs
Richardson: 2x (2-time) NBA Slam Dunk Contest champion (2002, 2003)
Jackson: 33 points and a then franchise playoff-record 7 three-pointers in the series-clinching Game 6 vs Dallas
Ellis: drafted 40th overall out of high school by Golden State in 2005; NBA Most Improved Player 2007; helped the Warriors defeat Dallas in six games
Beartic: it freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with
Sceptile: it agilely leaps about the branches of trees to strike
Dhelmise: swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow
Sawk: tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive
Zangoose adroitly dodges attacks with incredible agility
